description:
Access the king-of-the-hill dashboard here: [koth.b01lersc.tf](https://koth.b01lersc.tf)

Your score for each challenge depends on how well you do relative to others. You will gain points proportional to `1000 / sqrt(x)` where x is your rank for that challenge. Your score for all king-of-the-hill challenges will be summed with your score for jeopardy challenges when calculating the final CTFtime leaderboard.

The top 3 overall highest-scoring teams in king-of-the-hill will receive:
- 1st: $300 USD
- 2nd: $150 USD
- 3rd: $50 USD
